relationships.subject: Oxytocin
relationships.evidence_quote: Microinjection of oxytocin into the ACC attenuates NP animals’ detrimental and anxiety-like responses by enhancing inhibitory transmission and stimulating ACC interneurons’ behavioral responses (Li et al., 2021).

key_findings: Review: NP involves PAG, RVM, LHb, mPFC and ACC; ACC pyramidal hyperactivity drives NP and negative emotion.
Acupuncture analgesia involves synaptic plasticity, neurotransmitter balance, glial/neuroinflammation and metabolic regulation.
